learning_outcomes.title: Distance and midpoint in space
learning_outcomes.statement: Use Distance and Midpoint Formulas in Space.
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Distance = √[(x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)² + (z₂ − z₁)²]. Midpoint = ((x₁ + x₂)/2, (y₁ + y₂)/2, (z₁ + z₂)/2).

questions.instruction: Find the midpoint of the segment joining the two points.
questions.stem: Find the midpoint of the segment joining the two points. K(-2,-4,-4),\quad L(4,2,0)

parts.prompt: Determine the coordinates of midpoint M.

answer.model_answer_and_marking: Average the corresponding x, y and z coordinates separately. Correct component calculations and complete midpoint.
